name: How can I ensure my contractor uses genuinely Low-VOC materials for my project?
description: Ask your contractor for product data sheets or third-party certifications to verify VOC content. Hometelligent Inc. assists clients in sourcing these materials.

mainEntity.name: How can I ensure my contractor uses genuinely Low-VOC materials for my project?

acceptedAnswer.text: To ensure genuinely low-VOC materials are used, ask your contractor for product specifications, manufacturer data sheets, or third-party certifications (like GreenGuard or GREENGUARD Gold) for all proposed products. This documentation verifies their VOC content. A first-party insight is that Hometelligent Inc. works with clients to identify and source materials that align with their healthy home goals, integrating these choices into the project planning phase.
